picks.headline: OpenAI Details ChatGPT Work Cloud Environment and Model Selection
picks.why: Introduces persistent cross-session filesystems, cloud code execution, headless browser tools, and direct selection of GPT-5.6.
picks.title: Understanding ChatGPT Work

picks.headline: Quantization-Triggered Backdoors Bypass Standard Full-Precision Audits
picks.why: Demonstrates that models passing safety checks in full precision can activate malicious backdoors once quantized downstream to INT8 or 4-bit.
picks.title: Quantization-Triggered Backdoors in Language Models: Cross-Quantizer Transferability and the Validation--Deployment Gap

picks.headline: Prompt Injection Attack Discovered Embedded in Official Legal Filing
picks.why: Highlights a real-world application of indirect prompt injection designed to compromise automated document processing pipelines.
picks.title: Hiding Prompt Injection in Legal Filing

picks.headline: Multi-Layered LLM Defenses Fail Interdependently Under Attack Conditions
picks.why: Reveals positive failure correlations across defense tiers, causing stacked security guards to fail significantly more often than multiplicative math predicts.
picks.title: Layered LLM Defenses as an Ensemble: Access Tiers, Inference Cost, and the Measured Failure Correlation Between Defense Layers

picks.headline: ContextLeak Exfiltrates Sensitive LLM Agent Context via Tool Schemas
picks.why: Shows how adversarial tool names and descriptions induce agents to leak their full runtime context as routine invocation arguments.
picks.title: ContextLeak: Exfiltrating LLM Agent Context via Malicious Tools

picks.headline: LLM-Generated Infrastructure Code Shows Nearly 4x Vulnerability Density
picks.why: Benchmarking against human baselines proves AI-assisted IaC introduces drastically higher security defect rates than human engineers.
picks.title: Compared to What? A Human-Anchored Security Benchmark for LLM-Generated Infrastructure-as-Code

papers.headline: Decoupling Depth in Mixture-of-Experts Reduces Training Communication Overhead
papers.why: Concentrates expert capacity into fewer layers, cutting GPU cross-node communication overhead without degrading model performance.
papers.title: Training Communication-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Models with Layer Re-Configuration

papers.headline: Probabilistic Formalization of KV Cache Eviction Enables Decode-Time Correction
papers.why: Frames KV cache eviction as expectation estimation and provides a sampling method to correct errors introduced by evicted context entries.
papers.title: A Probabilistic Interpretation of KV Cache Eviction

papers.headline: Fast Weight Attention Formalizes Read-After-Write Semantics for Continual Learning
papers.why: Introduces the Falcon algorithm family to improve online updates and length extrapolation in recurrent fast-weight architectures.
papers.title: Fast Weight Attention for Continual Learning
